journal.text: Initial $50,000 account: deploy 50% equally into TMUS, ORLY, EXC, ROP and MNST; retain $25,000 cash. Observed 65-session histories show sharp deterioration in large technology stocks (MSFT 375.39, NVDA 108.38, AMZN 190.26), so avoid bottom-fishing and full exposure. Selected names have positive intermediate trends and recent relative strength: TMUS 266.71, ORLY 1432.58, EXC 46.08, ROP 589.58, MNST 58.52. ORLY and EXC are near period highs; position sizes limit breakout reversal risk. Dollar orders avoid unknown-opening-price sizing failures. Review daily; reconsider each position on a close below its March trading-range support (TMUS 252, ORLY 1283, EXC 42.55, ROP 560, MNST 54), or roughly 7% below entry / subsequent peak, with tighter review if relative strength fades. These are review thresholds, not standing stop orders. Add exposure only after broader trends stabilize or leaders consolidate constructively; do not automatically invest deposits.

Hold all five positions and $25,000 cash (~49.8% of equity). April 1 closes remain above the prior review levels: TMUS 268.54, ORLY 1431.80, EXC 45.92, ROP 590.78, MNST 59.04. Portfolio equity is $50,176.96. MSFT, NVDA and AMZN rebounded from the March 31 closes recorded in the initial journal, but one positive session is insufficient evidence that their deteriorating intermediate trends have reversed. No reason to churn newly established defensive leaders or increase exposure yet. Reconsider on closes below TMUS 252, ORLY 1283, EXC 42.55, ROP 560, MNST 54, or approximately 7% below entry/subsequent peak; these are review triggers, not executable stops. Reassess additions after sustained broader stabilization or constructive consolidation in leaders.

Hold five positions and $25,000 cash (49.9% of $50,079.48 equity). April 2 closes: TMUS 264.56, ORLY 1417.01, EXC 45.97, ROP 590.36, MNST 59.36. All remain above review thresholds; modest declines in TMUS and ORLY do not justify selling newly established positions. MSFT 382.14, NVDA 110.42 and AMZN 196.01 have improved from March 31, but two sessions of recovery do not establish intermediate trend repair. Maintain half exposure rather than chase the bounce. Reconsider on closes below TMUS 252, ORLY 1283, EXC 42.55, ROP 560, MNST 54, or roughly 7% below entry/subsequent peak; these are review triggers, not standing stops. Seek sustained broader stabilization and constructive leader consolidation before increasing exposure.

Hold five defensive leaders and $25,007.04 cash (49.7% of $50,307.88 equity). April 3 saw renewed deterioration: MSFT 373.11 (-2.4% versus prior journal close), NVDA 101.80 (-7.8%), AMZN 178.41 (-9.0%). No basis to buy the decline or raise overall exposure. Existing positions were resilient: TMUS 267.89, ORLY 1441.89, EXC 47.23 and MNST 59.65 rose; ROP slipped 1.8% to 579.70 but remains above its 560 review level. Maintain positions rather than extrapolate the broad selloff into still-intact defensive trends. Reconsider on closes below TMUS 252, ORLY 1283, EXC 42.55, ROP 560, MNST 54, or approximately 7% below entry/subsequent peak, whichever prompts earlier review. These are review triggers, not standing stops; overnight gaps remain a risk. Increase exposure only after sustained broad stabilization and constructive leader consolidation.

Reduce exposure by exiting TMUS and ROP; no buys. April 4 closes broke review levels: TMUS 248.11 versus 252, ROP 541.80 versus 560. Both fell over 6% on sharply increased volume and closed near session lows; ROP is also over 7% below entry and both are over 7% below recent closing peaks. Broad weakness persists: MSFT 359.84, NVDA 94.31, AMZN 171.00. Retain ORLY, EXC and MNST, whose closes remain above review levels and drawdown thresholds. Sales would leave approximately 70% cash at previous closes, though actual opening proceeds are unknown. Review remaining holdings below ORLY 1341, EXC 43.92, MNST 55.47 (approximately 7% below recent closing highs), or on further heavy-volume deterioration. These are review levels, not executable stops. Reconsider additions only after multiple sessions of stabilization and constructive leader recovery; do not assume a sharp rebound establishes trend repair.

Exit ORLY after April 7 close 1333.84 breached 1341 review level and fell 7.5% from April 3 closing high. Two successive declines on elevated volume, latest close near session low, outweigh its earlier defensive strength. Keep EXC and MNST: EXC 44.69 remains above 43.92 review level despite elevated selling volume; MNST 57.11 stabilized above 55.47. Sale leaves roughly 80% cash at prior closes; actual opening proceeds unknown. No buys: NVDA and AMZN bounced but exceptionally wide ranges and MSFT's further decline do not establish sustained recovery. Reconsider remaining positions on closes below EXC 43.92 or MNST 55.47, or renewed material deterioration. Reassess additions after multiple sessions of stabilization and constructive leader recovery; review triggers are not standing stops.

Exit MNST: April 8 close 55.01 broke the 55.47 review level and is 7.8% below April 3 closing peak. Decline of 3.7% on nearly twice prior-session volume, closing near the low, confirms deterioration. Retain EXC at 44.49, above 43.92 review level; its rising selling volume warrants close monitoring, but the latest decline was modest. Sale leaves approximately 90% cash at prior closes. No buys: MSFT, NVDA and AMZN all reversed strong openings into lower closes; sustained stabilization remains absent. Reconsider EXC below 43.92 or on further material deterioration. Reconsider modest additions after multiple sessions of stabilization and constructive leader recovery, rather than a single rebound. Review levels are not standing stops; opening execution prices unknown.

Hold EXC and cash (approximately 90% of equity); no new trades. April 9 produced a powerful high-volume rebound: MSFT 390.49, NVDA 114.33, AMZN 191.10 and META 585.77 closed near session highs. This materially improves recovery prospects, but follows failed rebounds and exceptionally wide ranges; avoid chasing a single explosive session at an unknown open. NFLX has three rising closes and recovered to 945.47, making it a candidate alongside MSFT if gains consolidate. EXC closed 44.30, down 0.4%, but recovered from 42.85 and remains above the 43.92 closing review level; retain the small position without adding. Reconsider EXC on a close below 43.92 or renewed substantial deterioration. Reconsider staged 5-10% equity additions after another constructive close or orderly pullback holding reclaimed levels (MSFT roughly 373-382; NFLX 917-936). These are review zones, not standing orders. Maintain flexibility rather than assuming either the rebound or the selloff must persist.

Hold EXC and $43,576 cash; no new trades. EXC rose 1.85% to 45.12, with a higher daily low and lower volume than the prior session; retain the approximately 10% position, reviewing on a close below 43.92 or renewed deterioration. April 10 retraced part of the explosive rebound: MSFT 381.35 (-2.34%), NFLX 921.17 (-2.57%), NVDA 107.57 (-5.91%), AMZN 181.22 (-5.17%). Lower volume and recovery from intraday lows are encouraging, particularly for MSFT, but broad daily ranges remain unusually large. MSFT and NFLX closed within our recovery review zones but traded materially below them intraday; this is not yet an orderly consolidation. Keep additions on watch rather than chase volatile opening prices. Reconsider a 5% starter in MSFT or NFLX if subsequent price action holds April 10 lows (367.80 and 894) and demonstrates tighter ranges or renewed closing strength. These are review criteria, not standing orders; avoid assuming cash should remain dominant once recovery becomes more durable.

Initiate $2,500 MSFT starter (approximately 5% of equity); retain EXC and $41,076 cash. April 11 MSFT rose to 388.45, held a higher low at 378.89 versus April 10's 367.80, and narrowed its daily range to 11.16 from 16.10. Close near the high and above the pre-selloff April 2 close meets the staged recovery criterion, although lighter volume means conviction remains limited. NVDA and AMZN also recovered with higher lows; META and NFLX lagged, so avoid a broad risk increase. NFLX closed 918.29 despite reaching 944.86 intraday; defer entry. EXC rose to 46 with another higher low; retain without adding. Review MSFT if it closes below 378.89, with a break of 367.80 materially invalidating recovery; consider additions after sustained closes above 393-395 or an orderly higher-low consolidation. Review EXC below 43.92 or renewed deterioration. Levels are review triggers, not automatic stops; today's opening prices remain unknown.

Hold EXC and MSFT; retain $41,076 cash. April 14 MSFT closed 387.81 after opening 393.22: higher low at 384.21 and lighter volume support consolidation, but failure to hold 393-395 argues against adding immediately. Review below 378.89, with 367.80 a more significant recovery failure; consider additions on sustained strength above 395. EXC closed 46.86 near its 47 high with another higher low; keep the approximately 10.5% position, reviewing below 43.92 or renewed deterioration. NFLX improved to 931.28 and its range narrowed, but closed below its opening price and well below 948.98 intraday; watch for a stronger close above 949 or further tight consolidation holding 919 before a starter. NVDA, AMZN and META also faded their openings, with META making a marginally lower low; broad recovery remains mixed. Existing small exposure balances participation with capital preservation; reconsider cash deployment as recovery becomes more durable. Review levels are not standing orders.

Buy $2,500 NFLX starter (~5.1% of equity); retain EXC and MSFT, leaving $38,576 cash. NFLX closed 976.28, up 4.83%, above the 949 recovery trigger and April 9 high, on 7.71m volume versus 4.04m prior session. This is meaningful relative strength while AMZN and META weakened. March resistance around 997-999 and the expanded daily range argue for a small starter rather than a full position. Review on a close below 948; a loss of 919 would materially undermine recovery. Consider adding only after holding the breakout or sustained strength above 999. MSFT narrowed its range but fell to 385.73 on lighter volume; retain starter without adding, reviewing below 378.89 and more seriously below 367.80. EXC consolidated at 46.74 with another higher low; retain, reviewing below 45.70 initially and 43.92 for material deterioration. Broad recovery remains mixed, so keep substantial cash. Review thresholds are not standing stop orders; opening fills remain unknown.

Exit MSFT starter; retain EXC and NFLX without adding. MSFT closed 371.61, down 3.66%, breaking the 378.89 review level with an expanded range and increased volume. Its low of 368 nearly retested the 367.80 recovery floor. Together with renewed weakness in NVDA, AMZN and META, this undermines the higher-low recovery thesis enough to exit rather than wait for a second break. Reconsider after reclaiming 379-385 with a durable higher low; stronger confirmation remains 393-395. NFLX pulled back on lower volume to 961.63, maintaining its breakout area with a 949.17 low: hold the small starter, review below 948 and especially 919; no additions without sustained strength. EXC closed 46.51, still above 45.70 support, though it faded a new short-term high; hold and review below 45.70, with 43.92 more material. Sale should leave roughly 84.4% cash at prior-close marks; actual opening proceeds unknown. Preserve capital until recovery breadth improves. Review levels are not standing orders.

Hold EXC and NFLX; preserve $40,952 cash (84.3% of equity). April 17 EXC rose to 47.26 with a higher low at 46.72, maintaining relative strength; existing 10.6% equity exposure is sufficient. Review below 45.70, with 43.92 more material. NFLX rose to 973.03 on increased volume and held a higher low at 956, supporting the small starter, but remains below 993-999 resistance. Consider adding after sustained closes above 999; review below 948 and especially 919. MSFT fell further to 367.78, NVDA to 101.49, and AMZN to 172.61; recovery in major growth names remains weak, supporting patience rather than redeploying sale proceeds. WMT and TMUS rebounded but remain below recent highs; no new position today. Reconsider cash deployment with durable higher lows and stronger recovery confirmation. Review thresholds are not standing orders; today's prices are unknown.

Hold EXC and NFLX; retain $40,952 cash (84.4% of equity). April 21 growth weakness deepened: MSFT 359.12, NVDA 96.91 and AMZN 167.32 all declined below recent lows. TMUS also deteriorated, so no new allocation. EXC fell 2.18% to 46.23 but recovered from 45.71, essentially testing the 45.70 review level without a closing break; retain existing roughly 10.4% position, reconsider on a close below 45.70, with 43.92 a more material failure. NFLX gained to 987.91 on increased volume and held a 973.05 low, showing relative strength, but faded an intraday 1019 high and did not close above 999. Keep the roughly 5.2% starter rather than chase; consider additions after sustained closes above 999 and a firm higher low. Review NFLX below 948, especially 919. Deploy more cash only as recovery becomes durable; current market weakness favors capital preservation. Levels are review triggers, not standing orders; today's opening prices are unknown.

Hold EXC and NFLX; retain $40,952 cash (83.9% of equity). April 22 rebound improved conditions but has not established a durable broad recovery: MSFT 366.82 remains below 379-385, NVDA 98.89 below 100, and AMZN 173.18 below 179-182. NFLX showed strong relative strength, closing 1040.34 with its entire session above 999 and a 1004.52 low. This is the first closing breakout, not yet sustained confirmation; keep the 5.5% starter rather than chase a 5.3% daily rise. Consider a measured addition after another close above 999 or an orderly successful retest; review a loss of 999, with below 948 a more serious failure. EXC recovered to 47.37 with a higher low, supporting the existing 10.6% allocation; review below 45.70, especially 43.92. WMT and TMUS rebounded but remain below recent highs. Deploy additional cash as higher lows and recovery follow-through develop. Thresholds are review levels, not standing orders; opening prices remain unknown.

Add $2,000 NFLX, raising exposure to approximately 9.6% at previous marks; retain EXC and $38,952 cash (79.9%). NFLX confirmed a second close above 999 at 1049.59, with a higher low at 1032 and a tighter range on lower volume. This supports a measured addition rather than full deployment. Review a close below 999 for trimming the addition; below 948 would materially weaken the remaining position. EXC closed 46.80, still above 45.70 support; hold its roughly 10.5% weight and reassess below 45.70, especially 43.92. Growth recovery improved: NVDA reclaimed 100 and AMZN closed 180.60, but both faded their opening gaps; MSFT at 374.39 remains below 379-385. Broad recovery is not yet convincing enough for aggressive buying. WMT remains below 96 closing resistance and TMUS below 267. Consider further diversification after sustained recovery closes and higher lows. All levels are review triggers, not standing orders; today's opening prices remain unknown.

Deploy $5,000 in measured recovery starters: MSFT $3,000 and AMZN $2,000. Retain EXC and NFLX; remaining cash $33,952.22, approximately 69% of prior-close equity. Three advancing sessions and strong April 24 closes improve the recovery evidence: MSFT reclaimed 379-385 at 387.30 with a higher low and increased volume; AMZN reclaimed 182 at 186.54 and held the prior day's low near 180.18. Neither has cleared its April 9-14 highs, so keep sizes modest rather than assume a durable uptrend. Review MSFT on a close below 373 and AMZN below 179; consider additions following sustained closes above 395 and 193 respectively or successful support retests. NFLX closed strongly at 1096.87; keep its roughly 10% weight without chasing another sharp advance. Review loss of 1032 for trimming, below 999 for a larger reduction. EXC remains above 45.70 at 46.33 but is lagging; reassess below 45.70, especially 43.92. NVDA recovery remains below 110-115 resistance, WMT below 96, TMUS below 267. These are discretionary review levels, not standing stops; opening gaps remain unknown.

Hold all four positions and $33,952.22 cash (69.3% of equity). April 25 extended the growth recovery, but recently initiated MSFT (391.85) and AMZN (188.99) remain below the 395 and 193 confirmation levels. Both posted higher lows; no reason to exit or rush additions. Consider adding after sustained closes above those levels or successful support retests; review closes below 373 and 179 respectively. NFLX consolidated its advance at 1101.53 on lower volume; retain its roughly 10% weight rather than chase. Review below 1032 for trimming, below 999 for larger reduction. EXC slipped to 46.22 but remains above 45.70; retain and reassess if that support breaks, especially below 43.92. NVDA reached 111.01 with increased volume, entering the 110-115 resistance zone; consider a modest starter on sustained clearance or a successful retest. WMT failed to sustain 96 and TMUS fell sharply to 232.77, so neither merits entry now. Recovery is improving but uneven; preserve flexibility while existing starters establish themselves. Review levels are discretionary, not standing stops; today's opening prices are unknown.

Hold four positions and $33,952.22 cash (69.3% of equity). April 28 provides consolidation, not fresh confirmation: MSFT 391.16 remains below 395 and AMZN 187.70 below 193, both declining on lighter volume. Retain modest starters; consider additions after sustained clearance or a convincing support retest, review closes below 373/179 respectively. NFLX advanced to 1110.38 and recovered its intraday dip; retain roughly 10% exposure without chasing. Review below 1032 for trimming and below 999 for larger reduction. EXC recovered to 46.48 after testing 45.83, holding 45.70 support; retain, reassess below 45.70 especially 43.92. NVDA retreated to 108.73, failing to sustain 110; wait for stronger evidence above 110-115 before entry. WMT 95.22 remains below 96; TMUS bounce to 236.77 does not repair its sharp breakdown. Cash preserves flexibility while recovery confirmation remains incomplete. Review levels are discretionary; today's opening prices unknown.

Hold four positions and $33,952.22 cash (69.1% of equity). April 29 strengthened existing holdings without resolving entry thresholds: MSFT 394.04 tested 395 but did not close above it; AMZN 187.39 recovered an opening drop yet remains below 193. Keep starters; consider additions on sustained clearance or convincing support retests, review closes below 373/179 respectively. NFLX 1125.64 continues leading and EXC 46.85 rebounded above 45.70 support; retain both without chasing. NFLX review below 1082 for deterioration, below 1032 for trimming and 999 for larger reduction; EXC review below 45.70, especially 43.92. WMT 96.04 only marginally cleared 96 on lighter volume and remains below recent 96.60 high; wait for sustained breakout before a starter. NVDA 109.02 remains below 110-115 resistance; TMUS 241.59 is rebounding but has not repaired its breakdown. Cash remains available for better-confirmed opportunities. Review levels are discretionary, not standing stops; today's open is unknown.

May deposit of $50,000 raises equity to $99,164.54. Deploy $9,000 selectively, leaving $74,952.22 cash rather than mechanically investing the deposit. Initiate WMT $6,000: April 30 closed 97.25 above 96.60 resistance after two closes above 96, with volume rising to 21.64m from 12.68m. Review a close below 94.30, especially 91.30; add only if breakout holds. Add $3,000 MSFT: close 395.26 marginally clears 395 and recovers a 384.44 intraday low on 36.46m volume. This supports a measured addition, not full allocation; review below 384 and reduce on deterioration below 373. Opening gaps remain unknown; dollar sizing caps spending. Hold NFLX and EXC: NFLX 1131.72 remains strong but extended, review below 1082/1032; EXC 46.90 holds support, review below 45.70 especially 43.92. Keep AMZN starter without adding: 184.42 remains below 193 and intraday weakness tested 179; reconsider below 179. NVDA 108.92 still has not sustained 110-115 clearance. Gradually increase exposure as recoveries confirm rather than chase every rebound. Levels are discretionary review triggers, not standing stops.

Deploy $10,000 selectively, leaving $64,952.22 cash (~65% of current equity). Initiate $4,000 each CRWD and MELI to broaden participation in the recovery without large individual bets. CRWD 431.88 has held its April 24 breakout across five subsequent closes, including recovery from April 30's 414.41 low; review below 414 and reduce on loss of 400. MELI 2294.52 pulled back on 303,900 volume versus 601,300 on the preceding advance, remaining above its prior 2249 area; review below 2200, especially 2129. Both are extended from April lows, so keep starters small and require consolidation before adding. Add $2,000 WMT: May 1 retested 96.59 and closed 97.41, supporting the 96.60 breakout. Review below 94.30, especially 91.30. Hold MSFT after its sharp gap to 425.40: high volume confirms demand but closing near the session low argues against chasing; watch 424.90 and gap retention, reassess materially below 407/395. Hold NFLX, EXC and AMZN; prior review levels remain 1082/1032, 45.70/43.92 and 179 respectively. AMZN still below 193; NVDA 111.61 remains below 115 resistance. All levels are discretionary close-based reviews, not standing stops; opening prices unknown. Dollar orders limit spending.

Hold seven positions and $64,952.22 cash (65.2% of equity) after deploying $19,000 over the last two sessions. May 2 supports existing exposure: MSFT closed 435.28 with its gap intact, WMT advanced to 98.75 above 96.60, and CRWD reached 440.58. Avoid immediate further additions after sharp advances; prefer consolidation or support retests. NFLX remains strong at 1156.49; raise initial deterioration review to 1100, retaining 1082/1032 as deeper review levels. MELI slipped to 2280.69 with a 2257.39 low, still above the prior 2249 breakout area; no addition until stabilization, review below 2200/2129. AMZN 189.98 still failed to clear 193 despite heavy volume; retain small starter, reconsider below 179. NVDA touched 115.40 but closed 114.50, so sustained clearance of 115 remains unconfirmed. Other discretionary close-based review levels: MSFT 424.90 then 407/395; CRWD 414/400; WMT 94.30/91.30; EXC 45.70/43.92. Cash available for confirmed entries, not a permanent allocation target. No standing stops; today's opening prices unknown.

Hold seven positions and $64,952.22 cash. May 5 was mixed rather than confirmation for further deployment: MSFT 436.17, WMT 99.33 and CRWD 443.47 retained strength, while NVDA 113.82 again failed to close above 115. Keep cash available for sustained breakouts or orderly support retests. MELI 2246.54 has slipped marginally below the prior 2249 breakout area after three declining closes; volume eased to 294,200, so retain the small starter but do not average down. Reconsider below 2200, especially 2129, or add only after stabilization and recovery of 2281-2295. NFLX recovered from 1107.01 to 1134.06 but fell on increased volume; watch 1100/1082 and reduce on material deterioration. EXC recovered its intraday breach of 45.70 to close 46; a closing loss of 45.70 prompts review, with 43.92 deeper support. AMZN 186.35 remains below 193; retain small exposure, review below 179. Other close-based review levels remain MSFT 424.90 then 407/395, CRWD 414/400, WMT 94.30/91.30. No standing stops; today's opening prices unknown.

Hold seven positions and $64,952.22 cash. May 6 shows consolidation rather than a fresh entry: MSFT 433.31 and WMT 98.55 pulled back on lighter volume, CRWD recovered from 430.57 to 443.21, and NFLX held 1137.69. Existing exposure remains intact; no reason to chase or sell these leaders. MELI is the main concern: fourth declining close at 2229 with volume rising to 475,900, and low 2206.88. Do not average down; review for reduction on a close below 2200, especially loss of 2129; require recovery of 2281-2295 before considering additions. EXC 46.29 held above 45.70. AMZN 185.01 remains a small unconfirmed recovery position, review below 179 and require clearance of 193 for additions. NVDA 113.54 still below 115, so no entry. Other close-based review levels: MSFT 424.90 then 407/395; WMT 94.30/91.30; CRWD 414/400; NFLX 1100/1082; EXC 45.70/43.92. Cash remains available for sustained breakouts or orderly support retests, not a permanent target. No standing stops; opening prices unknown.

Buy a $4,000 NVDA starter; retain other holdings. NVDA closed 117.06 above the repeatedly tested 115-115.40 ceiling and all highs in the supplied 25-session window, with volume 206.8m above the prior three sessions. One close is not sustained confirmation, so limit initial exposure to 4% and leave $60,952.22 cash. Consider adding after holding 115 or an orderly successful retest; review a close below 112.28, especially 110.82, for failed breakout. CRWD is now the main risk: -4.7% to 422.52 on 6.67m shares, gapping below recent consolidation. Its small position remains above 414/400 review levels; do not average down, reduce if 414 fails or weakness persists without recovery toward 430. MELI rebounded to 2262.09 on increased volume; retain, require 2281-2295 recovery for additions and review below 2200/2129. MSFT 433.35 and WMT 98.83 consolidate; NFLX 1155.41 approaches recent highs. Retain review levels MSFT 424.90 then 407/395, WMT 94.30/91.30, NFLX 1100/1082, EXC 45.70/43.92. AMZN 188.71 remains below 193 entry confirmation; review below 179. Opening prices unknown; dollar buy limits spending. No standing stops.

Reduce EXC by half; add $2,000 each to NVDA and MSFT. EXC closed 45.10 below the 45.70 review level and near its session low, breaking the recent range; retain only a smaller defensive position, review remaining shares below 43.92 and require recovery above 45.70 before rebuilding. NVDA held its breakout for a second close at 117.37 with an intraday low of 115.85; modestly increase to roughly 6% exposure, review below 115 and reduce on failure of 112.28/110.82. MSFT consolidated its large upward gap for a week and closed 438.17; add to roughly 8.5% exposure, review below 424.90 with deeper support 407/395. Cash remains ample, around $59.4k depending on EXC fill. MELI surged to 2410 on 906k volume but faded from 2501 after opening 2470; retain rather than chase, watch 2380/2349 for stabilization and 2295 for failed gap. CRWD recovered toward 430; hold, no averaging down, review below 414. AMZN still lacks a close above 193; hold starter. WMT pulled back to 97.43 but remains above 94.30/91.30; NFLX remains above 1100/1082. Retain both. Dollar buys are funded by existing cash; opening prices unknown, review levels are not standing stops.

Exit CRWD and add $2,000 to MELI; retain other positions. CRWD closed 410.57 below the 414 review level after a second downward gap in three sessions, with 4.69m volume exceeding the intervening rebound's 3.62m. Failed recovery toward 430 warrants exiting rather than averaging down. Reconsider after sustained recovery of 424-430. MELI held its large gap with a higher low of 2413.86 and close of 2450; increase modestly to about 6% exposure, not a full-sized bet after a sharp advance. Review below 2380/2349 and reduce on a failed gap below 2295. AMZN closed only fractionally above 193 on lighter volume; retain starter and await stronger clearance of 194.69 before adding. NVDA held 115 on lower volume; retain, review below 115 and reduce on 112.28/110.82 failure. MSFT remains firm; review 424.90. NFLX consolidates on lighter volume; review 1100/1082. WMT has weakened for two sessions but remains above 94.30/91.30; no addition. Smaller EXC position held 45.21; review below 43.92, require 45.70 recovery before rebuilding. Cash approximately $61k after trades at unknown opens preserves flexibility. Review levels are not standing stops.

Exit remaining EXC; deploy $12k across AMZN, META, NVDA and MSFT, bringing invested exposure to approximately 48% at prior closes. EXC broke 43.92, closing 43.61 on 9.91m volume, with another failed gap; reconsider only after recovery of 44.50 then 45.70. AMZN decisively cleared 194.69 to 208.64 on 75.2m shares. Add $3k, but size moderately because it closed below its opening price after a large gap; review 205.75, reduce on failed recovery below 194.69. META starter $5k: 639.43 close near session high, above recent 611.30 ceiling on increased volume; review 621, reduce on failed breakout below 611/596. NVDA closed at session high 123 on increased volume after several sessions holding 115; add $2k, review 120.28/118 and reduce on 115 failure. MSFT cleared 443.67 and closed near its high; add $2k to roughly 10.6% weight, review 435/431 then 424.90. These correlated growth additions remain measured following sharp gaps; approximately $51.7k cash remains, depending on EXC fill. Retain MELI, WMT and NFLX without additions. MELI continues higher; review 2414/2380. NFLX's high-volume decline to 1110 is concerning; reduce if 1100/1082 fails or weakness persists without recovery toward 1130. WMT remains above 94.30/91.30 support. No assumption about catalysts or today's unknown prices; review levels are not standing stops.

Hold all seven positions after yesterday's $12k deployment; cash $51,672.74, invested exposure 48.7%. Growth positions broadly confirmed their breakouts, but successive sharp advances argue against another immediate increase in correlated exposure. NVDA rose to 129.93 on 330.4m shares; retain, review 124.47/123 then 120.28, with deeper failure below 115. META held above 642.83 and closed 656.03; review 639/621, reduce on failed breakout below 611. AMZN held its gap with low 210.10; review 205.75, then 194.69. MSFT consolidated at 449.14; review 439.78/435 then 424.90. MELI retained its gap at 2515.12; review 2443/2414 then 2380. NFLX recovered above 1130 to 1138.44, alleviating immediate exit concern; retain, reconsider below 1100/1082. WMT is the laggard at 95.88 with lower highs and lows; no averaging down, reduce if 94.30 fails without recovery, deeper support 91.30. Reconsider measured additions after orderly consolidation or further sustained breakout confirmation rather than chasing today's unknown open. Review levels are not standing stops.

Hold seven positions; invested exposure 49.0%, cash $51,692.43. Trends remain constructive but no compelling fresh entry after rapid advances. NVDA closed 135.34 near its high, up roughly 16% from Friday: let existing position run without chasing; review 129.93/124.47, then 123. MSFT made another higher low and closed 452.94; retain, review 445.36/439.78. AMZN pulled back to 210.25 on declining volume, consistent with consolidation rather than gap failure; consider adding after stabilization above 205.75 and renewed strength toward 214.84, reduce on failed gap below 194.69. META consolidated at 659.36 on lighter volume; review 642.83/639, then 621/611. MELI closed at its high at 2564 but volume declined; no addition, review 2491/2443 then 2380. NFLX recovered to 1150.99; retain, review 1128/1100/1082. WMT rebounded with a higher low and increased volume; retain without averaging down, review 95.23/94.30.
